text_block_list.text:
Vodka's honed dash power bore fruit in 
this race. Even more than the victory 
itself, the gains she made were immense.

Furthermore, before she even realized it 
herself, she had pulled off a stunning, 
back-to-back Yasuda Kinen victory in the 
coolest way possible.

Having gained unmatched sharpness, Vodka 
wears a fearless smirk, confident that she 
won't lose to anyone.

To battle her rival Daiwa Scarlet with 
that powerful and utterly cool weapon of 
hers, Vodka sets her sights on the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)!
